description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing a fixed deposit account in the Fineract lending platform. It extends DepositAccountData and encapsulates properties related to fixed deposit accounts, including deposit terms, interest details, account linkage, and closure options. The class includes multiple static factory methods for creating instances with various configurations, and overrides equals and hashCode methods for identity comparison.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a Fixed Deposit account, extending DepositAccountData and including specific fields for fixed deposit parameters, account linkage, interest, closure options, and factory methods for creation.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new FixedDepositAccountData instance with common deposit parameters and imported data, including submission date, interest periods, deposit amount, and deposit period.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a configured FixedDepositAccountData instance with detailed parameters, including linked account, transfer options, and account closure options.

methods.name: associationsAndTemplate
methods.description: Method to create a new FixedDepositAccountData with associations and template options, used for populating account details with related data and configurations.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Creates a new FixedDepositAccountData with an interest rate chart overlay.

methods.name: withTemplateOptions
methods.description: Populates a FixedDepositAccountData with template options such as product, interest, and account options.

methods.name: withClientTemplate
methods.description: Creates a FixedDepositAccountData pre-populated with client and group info, serving as a template for new accounts.

methods.name: preClosureDetails
methods.description: Returns a FixedDepositAccountData with details relevant for account pre-closure, including maturity amount and closure options.

methods.name: withClosureTemplateDetails
methods.description: Populates a FixedDepositAccountData with closure account options and associated data.
